sloka: अहम् दाशरथेनोढा मोहात्स्वकुपांसनी ।आर्यपुत्रस्य रामस्य भार्या मृत्युरजायत ।। ६-३२-२९।।
transliteration: aham dāśarathenoḍhā mohātsvakupāṁsanī ।āryaputrasya rāmasya bhāryā mṛtyurajāyata ।। 6-32-29।।

translations.english: "In ignorance as an obloquy of his race, the noble son of Dasaratha married me. For such Rama's wife turned out to be his death."
